mustPreserve: Two-factor state changes and visible status.
Recovery email validation and local save acknowledgement.
The session overflow control and declared element IDs.
mustDeliver: Every interactive control has an accessible name and keyboard behaviour.
Programmatic labels, logical headings and visible focus.
Readable contrast and a reduced-motion path.
mustNot: Redesign the page into a marketing surface.

functionalChecks.action: Toggle two-factor with pointer and keyboard.
functionalChecks.expected: State and visible status update in both cases.

functionalChecks.action: Submit an invalid email, then a valid email.
functionalChecks.expected: Invalid input is explained and valid input produces a local acknowledgement.

functionalChecks.action: Reach and activate the session overflow control by keyboard.
functionalChecks.expected: The control has an understandable name and exposes a local menu or acknowledgement.
No control navigates to a placeholder # target.
Content appears without non-essential entrance motion.
